# Digital Macaroni

> Digital Macaroni builds AI agents that take action inside real business workflows: voice agents, software and automations that turn conversations into completed work.

## Start here

- [Official information](https://digitalmacaroni.io/llm-info.txt): the full fact sheet: what we build, use cases by business type, integrations, pricing and example projects.
- [About](https://digitalmacaroni.io/about/): what Digital Macaroni does and who it builds for.
- [Pricing](https://digitalmacaroni.io/pricing.md): agents, running plans and extras in plain text.
- [Contact](https://digitalmacaroni.io/contact/): start a project or ask a question.

## Voice agent architecture

How AI voice agents are built, with a live demo of each architecture: https://digitalmacaroni.io/architecture/

- [Speech-to-speech (single bidirectional model)](https://digitalmacaroni.io/architecture/speech-to-speech/): one model hears, reasons, calls tools and speaks in one live stream. Demo: Northline, on Google Gemini 3.8 Live.
- [Managed voice platform](https://digitalmacaroni.io/architecture/managed-voice-platform/): a voice platform runs the conversation while tools and data stay on our server. Demo: Form & Field, on ElevenLabs Agents.
- [Cascade: speech-to-text, LLM, text-to-speech](https://digitalmacaroni.io/architecture/stt-llm-tts-cascade/): separate models hear, think and speak, with our own turn-taking. Demo: Waypoint Travel, on AssemblyAI and Google Gemini.

## Example projects

- [Northline](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/northline/): example voice agent for a fictional home-services business.
- [Form & Field](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/formfield/): example voice agent for a fictional shop.
- [Waypoint Travel](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/travel/): example voice agent for a fictional travel agency.

## Our own products

- [RankLadder](https://rankladder.app): customer conversations and front-office tools for local businesses.
- [Hey Anders](https://heyanders.com): an AI assistant and workspace for appointment-based practices.
- [TwoTop](https://twotop.app): hospitality scheduling, communication and team operations.
